104 CRORE RUPEES. That’s how much Asmita Patel allegedly made—not from trading but from selling false dreams of stock market success. She called herself the ""She-Wolf of the Stock Market"" and promised people 40% guaranteed returns with just 15 minutes of trading a day. Sounds too good to be true? It was.
SEBI’s investigation exposed the truth. While she claimed to manage a Rs 283 crore portfolio, her actual trading volume was only Rs 15 crore, with profits of just Rs 12 lakh over five years.
